item.alone_adventure.crystalline_heart.t: A heart condensed from crystal, the crystals on it still shifting in color.
Regenerates 1 shield every 10 seconds after taking damage
Higher armor and armor toughness increase shield capacity and regen speed
item.alone_adventure.bleedingshield.tool: A shield forged from congealed blood, the blood still seeks to erode its wielder.
Every 2 armor points or 1 health point sacrificed converts to 1 armor toughness
item.alone_adventure.adaptive_flesh.tool: A squirming piece of living tissue that seems to learn alongside your pain.
Each hit of a damage type grants 1 layer of adaptation (15% per layer, max 5); taking a different damage type decays all existing layers by 1
item.alone_adventure.night_contract.tool: A pact signed in blood; moonlight is its gift, sunlight its curse.
In sunlight (daytime, unobstructed sky): health cannot regenerate, and you are afflicted with Wither
At night (indoors or outdoors): restores 1 health every 4 seconds and grants Night Vision
Can sleep during the day; sleeping in daylight skips straight to nightfall
Brighter moon phases grant higher bonuses: new moon +10%, up to full moon +50% movement speed and crit damage
Current moon: %1$s -- +%2$s movement speed and crit damage
item.alone_adventure.broken_mask.tooltip: A cracked stone mask, whispering of a forgotten pact.
20% chance on hit to inflict Vulnerability I (10s) on the target
When the target's Vulnerability is consumed: 50% chance to gain Strength I (5s) and restore 10 health
Base: +7 Armor, +20% Max Health, +3 Armor Toughness
Active skill (default key R): inflict Vulnerability II (1 min) on all entities within 8 blocks; heal half of max health and gain Resistance II (1 min); 90s cooldown
item.alone_adventure.binding_bandage.too: An old herb-soaked bandage; the tighter it binds, the less willing you are to fall.
30% chance on hit to give yourself Endurance I (3s: +speed, +jump, hunger locked); does not stack or refresh
Active skill (default key R): gain 1 shield point (max 3), 3 min cooldown; incoming damage is negated and costs 1 shield point
item.alone_adventure.survival_whimper.to: A whimper that refuses to die; uses your last breath to escape death.
On a fatal blow: immune to this damage
Teleports back to your respawn point (or world spawn if no bed)
item.alone_adventure.dragon_power.toolti: The bloodline of dragons flows within; death itself dares not claim you.
On a fatal blow: immune to this damage and revive in place with full health
item.alone_adventure.parryshield.tooltip: Raise this shield at the moment an enemy strike lands for a perfect defense.
Block within 1s of raising: full immunity, reflects 250% damage and weakens the attacker for 3s (1s parry cooldown)
Held up longer: absorbs 80% of the damage
A mysterious weapon of an imperial far future, its blade driven by highly compressed energy, cleaving far beyond ordinary alloys.

Pierce: main attacks ignore armor toughness; against enemies with armor above 8, +0.3 damage per point over the threshold, and +0.5 per point of toughness above 6 (up to 10 total), this damage ignores armor and toughness

Overclock: activate with right-click (lasts 13s by default, costs 5 durability), grants Resistance II for 5s on activation, +50% attack damage while active, +3 fire damage and 4s ignition per hit, heals 60% of damage dealt; 30s cooldown (duration and cooldown configurable)
item.alone_adventure.chainsawsword.toolt: A mysterious imperial weapon from 39 millennia in the future, relying on serrated teeth to cut through foes.

Tear: Normal hits stack 4 levels, sweep hits have a 50% chance to stack 2 levels (refreshes on hit). When duration ends, settle once for damage = level × 0.6, then halve the level, re-apply with half level and continue settling until level reaches zero.

Sweep: Right-click to activate (lasts 7s, costs 3 durability, 15s cooldown). During activation, deals 1 damage every 0.2s to entities in front within 6 blocks cone (blocked by obstacles), and stacks 2 Laceration levels on hit (50% chance).
item.alone_adventure.painstrike_hammer.t: A brutal heavy hammer that punishes every blow, breaking down the enemy's guard.
item.alone_adventure.ink_blade.tooltip.d: Ink condensed into blades; they scatter on impact and slowly reclaim themselves from the void.
item.alone_adventure.ink_blade.tooltip.t: Right-click to throw a blade: deals 2 damage and inflicts Weakness I (5s), 0.15s cooldown
item.alone_adventure.ink_blade.tooltip.d: Forged of ink, it never breaks: each throw costs 1 durability, idle blades regen 1 per 0.5s (2 per second)
item.alone_adventure.sealed_throne.toolt: A throne crystallized from starlight; its wearer will gradually draw forth its radiance.
Each star +2% attack damage; every 4 stars +2 armor
When hit and hearts are actually lost, lose 2 stars (shield absorption prevents star loss)
Active skill (default R): consume all stars, gain 1 shield per 3 stars, gain equal yellow hearts (20s)
tooltip.alone_adventure.golden_beetroot: Grants Endurance I for 60 seconds when eaten, also used to brew Endurance Potion
item.alone_adventure.injection_empty.too: An empty syringe used to craft potion syringes
tooltip.alone_adventure.injection_templa: This syringe has no effects (place a potion in the crafting grid)
item.alone_adventure.imperial_eagle.tool: The two-headed eagle emblem of the Imperium, symbolizing glory and immortality.
Inverts negative effects: Weakness->Strength, Slowness->Speed, Darkness->Night Vision, Poison->Regeneration
Immune to fire and lava damage
Active skill (default key R): Resistance II, Strength I, Regeneration II for 2 minutes, 30s cooldown
item.alone_adventure.starlight_greatswor: A heavy blade awash with starlight; the longer it is held, the brighter it glows.
Charge: held in hand it gathers 1 starlight layer every 3 seconds (max 20)
On hit: base 15 damage, +10% per layer, and damage absorption (golden hearts, stacks every 3 seconds), then the charge resets
